title: Closure edges
description: The edges the matrix's dependency relationships between what the Tasks build make between Tasks of different Stories (<work>/closure-edges.json): the step `beadwrite.closure_task_edges` (orchestrator/flows/task_edges.py) writes beadwrite.closure_task_edges' result and validates it against this file. An item's build need (`requires`: every architecture-side dependency relationship but publishing, matching and calling) becomes an edge only when one Task builds the item; when several Tasks of its Story build it, the need is listed in `itemNeeds` instead of fanned out onto all of them. The task-dependency-mapper is handed it as `closure edges`: these edges stand, the mapper places each item need on the candidate Tasks that consume the required item, and it adds only edges the file does not hold.

from.description: The prerequisite Task key, S<i>-<local key>.

to.description: The dependent Task key, S<i>-<local key>.

kind.description: What the dependent Task needs from the prerequisite (task-deps.schema.json, TaskDepsEdgeKind).

reason.description: Which item requires which, and through which matrix relationship.

itemNeeds.description: Each build need of an item that several Tasks of its Story build: which of them consume the required item is the task-dependency-mapper's judgment, from the Tasks' content.

item.description: The item the candidate Tasks build.

requires.description: The item it needs built first.

kind.description: What a consuming Task needs (task-deps.schema.json, TaskDepsEdgeKind).

reason.description: Which item requires which, and through which matrix relationship.

from.description: The Tasks of another Story that build the required item, S<i>-<local key>.

candidates.description: The Tasks that build the item, S<i>-<local key>; an edge goes only to those that consume the required item.

warnings.description: Each requirement no Task of the span builds; a warning fails the step.
